_about: Raising inputs (List 35, #338): the CLOSED read set for #337's drift engine. The engine founds no tracking of its own — every family is recorded by its owning system for its own reasons. A fact nobody records reads as absent (weight zero), never estimated. Adding a family is a proposal into this file, never a system's own decision (the #164 kinds / #149 screen-classes closure discipline).

readDiscipline.absence: an unrecorded family contributes nothing; an unrecorded childhood is NOT a neglected one (neglect is a recorded fact in family 2, not a paperwork gap)
readDiscipline.shape: patterns across the life, recency-weighted (weights are balance data) — never last-act-only: one feast is not a raising, a childhood of feasts is
readDiscipline.wild: encounter-generated equivalents (#243/#214 family) — thinner records read thinner, never padded
